definition.title: Refresh the content that stopped working
definition.description: Read Search Console for the pages already published, separate real decay from seasonality, SERP change and self-competition, and give every page one verdict: refresh, consolidate, retarget, retire or leave alone.

window_days.title: Comparison window (days)
window_days.description: Each window is this long. The report compares the most recent complete window with the one immediately before it.

as_of_utc.title: Optional UTC end date, exclusive
as_of_utc.description: Leave blank to roll forward on every run. A fixed date keeps a scheduled run reproducible but stops it tracking new data.

maturation_days.title: Leave pages alone until they are this old
maturation_days.description: A page younger than this is still establishing. It is reported as too young to judge rather than as decayed.

max_pages.title: How many pages to give a verdict

exclude_paths.title: Optional path prefixes to leave out
exclude_paths.description: One prefix per line, for example /docs/ or /legal/. Pages under these prefixes are excluded before ranking.

page_notes.title: Optional page intent, publication dates and last refresh dates
page_notes.description: Plain prose. Anything you say about when a page was published, last updated, or what it is meant to do.

seasonality_notes.title: Optional known seasonality, launches or campaigns
seasonality_notes.description: Plain prose. Anything that already explains a rise or fall in this window.

human_review.reason: Consolidating or retiring a published page is irreversible for search traffic and should be read before anyone acts on it.
human_review.summary: Verdicts on published pages, with the evidence behind each one.
